name: scrape_url
description:
Scrape tool fetches content from a webpage. Arguments are URL and optional "query" string.
- If query is provided: extracts only content relevant to the query
- If query is empty or omitted: returns the entire page content
Can only scrape HTML/web pages. Cannot scrape PDF files.
arguments_prompt:
Provide arguments for the scrape tool. The scrape tool fetches website content and optionally extracts relevant portions.

Arguments:
- url (str, required): The webpage URL to scrape
- query (str, optional): What to extract from the page
  - If provided: scraper agent extracts only content relevant to this query
  - If empty/omitted: returns the entire page content without summarization

Example with query:
{"url": "https://example.com/menu", "query": "Find restaurant hours and prices"}

Example without query (full page):
{"url": "https://example.com/menu", "query": ""}
or
{"url": "https://example.com/menu"}
